reasoning: This is a project-wide code review/investigation to find bugs. It spans 3 services (docs-site, control-server, shared) and requires systematic analysis of tests, documentation, and runtime behavior. No external integrations or infrastructure changes needed, but requires thorough cross-service exploration.

scope.notes: Investigation spans docs-site (React), control-server (Fastify), and shared library. Will need to review tests, UI components, API routes, and Docker compose configurations.

integrations.notes: No new integrations. Existing integrations (OpenAI, Docker, ElevenLabs) are already configured - just need to verify they work correctly.

infrastructure.notes: No infrastructure changes needed. Investigation only - may identify issues in docker-compose.yml or environment configs but won't modify them in this phase.

knowledge.notes: Well-documented project with CLAUDE.md, existing tests (Vitest, Playwright), and clear architecture. Patterns for testing and validation exist.

concerns: May miss subtle bugs without comprehensive test coverage
Documentation might be outdated vs implementation
Need running Docker environment to fully test some features
risk.notes: Investigation is read-only, so low risk of introducing regressions. Main risk is in thoroughness of the review.

validation_recommendations.reasoning: Investigation task should run all existing test suites to identify failures. Unit tests verify component behavior, integration tests check API functionality, and E2E tests validate the complete user workflows described in documentation.

review_targets: docs-site/src/components - UI components and wizard flow
docs-site/tests - Playwright E2E tests for expected behavior
control-server/tests - Vitest unit tests for backend logic
CLAUDE.md and README - Documentation of expected behavior
verification_methods: Run npm run check (lint + tests + smoke)
Run npm test in both workspaces
Compare documentation claims vs actual implementation
Review error handling and edge cases
